As a first time cat mom who adopted a stray that kept coming back and had some previous injuries I was SO grateful for this team. The veterinarian AND the assistant veterinarian were so kind, calm, and informative. I had a lot of questions and I had known this cat for three days, but they moved with calm confidence that taught me a lot.
They did not rush either one of us, (me or my cat) which I honestly valued more than I could express in the moment. Prices were discussed with full informed consent before he was out of his carrier. I am deeply grateful. I don’t normally review things unless it is useful. I believe it is important that people know how incredible they are, because it is rare.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

Nice care they took care of my dog pretty well I liked it. It’s just I had to wait for a long time.

Dr Rainey Biler and Leah are great! Today Dr. Dagher saw my doggo and she was wonderful too!!
Super friendly, mocha loves them on her visits to get seen!
I love this place! The staff were gentle. Very informative.
Dr. DiShinger and her tech Mandy where both amazing and helpful. Although we showed up a little late the still saw us.

Cannot believe this place would not honor a free wellness coupon for my kitty, based on I brought another pet, my cat that died a year ago, and so now that I'm in their system I cannot bring a New Pet in for a 1st time wellness exam, DESPICABLE service

Great experience all around . Always is at the San Pedro location . No matter what vet or tech you get they are all absolutely outstanding . Customer service & transparency is top tier . Will continue using this clinic for all future dog or cat related issues and vaccinations.
Dr. Rainy & techs Jake & Raquel were fantastic. Even reception was great 💪
Brought mu new cat Kneazy here for his first check up. Everyone was so sweet and knowledgeable! I will definitely be back and thank you guys so much. Dr. Rainey Biter, Leah and Raquel!!!
They kept calling me “dad,” and I didn’t have the heart to tell them my dog was more like a part-time employee. 10/10 would recommend.

I had a very concerning experience with my dog Charlie’s appointment on April 18th at 5 PM.

Before anything began, I clearly informed staff that Charlie is a nervous but non-aggressive dog who does not do well with multiple people in his face. This was ignored.

His weight was not properly taken—the scale hadn’t settled, yet staff guessed 80 lbs when it was visibly closer to his normal ~73 lbs.

Charlie was taken to the back despite being uncomfortable going without me. After waiting over 20 minutes, I heard him barking repeatedly—something he has never done at any prior vet visit.

Dr. Rae Dishinger entered without introducing herself and immediately labeled my dog “aggressive” multiple times. Charlie has never bitten or attempted to bite anyone. He was returned to me wearing a muzzle, which has never been necessary before.

What’s most concerning is that both the assistant and Dr. Dishinger later admitted Charlie was calm and relaxed when with me and my mother. The assistant also confirmed that multiple staff members were in his face in the back—exactly what I had asked them not to do.

During the exam, I calmly and gently guided the assistant out of Charlie’s face to his side to help keep him comfortable. This was not aggressive behavior on my part, yet it was never acknowledged.

The exam itself was not even completed until we questioned it. Basic checks like teeth, ears, and eyes were initially skipped. Despite Charlie being calm in the room, sedation was repeatedly pushed.

Communication throughout the visit was poor and unprofessional:

* No proper introduction from the veterinarian
* No transparency about what was happening in the back
* Incomplete exam without explanation
* Medication incorrectly provided as a 1-month supply without discussion

After leaving, I received a voicemail from management stating my dog would not be seen again unless sedated—something never clearly communicated during the visit.

Charlie showed fear, not aggression. My concerns were ignored, and my dog was handled in a way that escalated his stress instead of managing it.

I will not be returning and would not trust this clinic with my pet’s care.
First time at the San Pedro location and it was THE BEST!!
Great team help me with my new pet

Visited Vetco Total Care to get my dog up to date on his vaccines and solve some tummy issues. The staff who took care of us, Dr. Rainey Biler and Leah, were awesome! Answered all of my questions and were tremendous with my pet Petey. Very positive atmosphere all around. Will be retuning for any future vet services!
My dog loves them. They take great care of my baby shows him amazing love and care I wouldn’t go anywhere else🥹🤍 …
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

Friendly staff, short waits, and decent prices. Been bouncing around vets since moving to SA several years ago but couldn't find one I liked. Very surprised that the best one so far has been Vetco! I think I was there for under 45 minutes and at no point did I feel rushed. Definitely switching all my pets to Vetco! They weren't pushy and listened to what I wanted, which is so important in a world of "you HAVE to get this or you're a bad owner!!"

Specific to the San Pedro Location!!! The staff and Vets who work at this location are AMAZING!! Great Customer Service. You can feel & see how much they care!! My Dex sees all his friends each time we go!! Sometimes I think He just misses them so much that He gets injured so we can go see the people who give him yummy treats at San Pedro's Vetco!!
Everyone there were so attentive and treated my doggy with so much care. I would highly recommend this place. Very affordable!

Dr. Rainey Biker and Jare are the best of the best! They treated my dog Hanna so well and made her feel comfortable and cared for. I absolutely love coming here now. This facility is wonderful, and all of the staff are so kind and professional. We always have a great experience and highly recommend them!

Thank you to Dr. Rainey Biler and his assistant Leah . They were great with my drama king Archie today. He had a second ulcer follow up and did various tests to make sure there is nothing else underlying this second ulcer. Leah has always been so kind towards my Archie always letting either Dr Deville and/or Dr. Biler know the drama king Archie is all talk but no bite.. lol she is so sweet with my Archie! I feel like I can trust them with my babies.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Dr Rainey Biker and Leah took amazing care of my puppy. They were wonderful and gave her excellent service.
My cat Veelvitta had a toothache, and she received excellent care. Everyone was gentle and attentive toward her.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

This little guy was recovered from underneath a car in my neighbors driveway. When Dr Rainey saw him, he was covered in fleas and ticks. After the wellness check and some testing, he was underweight, dehydrated and very anemic. His tests showed hookworms, Anaplasmosis and a critical blood count. The only option was to work with him and see if he would get better. Becca, Leah and TJ were very understanding, empathetic and gentle not just with this sick dog but with me. It was a very emotional time to see a dog so sick. I worked daily with him on a high protein diet, protein snacks, Iron drops and multi Vitamin B drops. We followed up in 1 month and he gained almost 2lbs and his labs were in normal range. The foster family fell through so he is still with me and I’m still working to get his weight up and improve his health.  Dr Rainey, Becca, Leah and TJ saved his life and were a comfort to me when I didn’t know what to do. I’m so appreciative to the compassion they showed.

We love this location! Everyone is so kind and really cares about your pet’s health and safety! I always feel very well taken care of, heard, and know that my pup is getting the best care! Thank you so much to this wonderful team of kind folks!

Everyone was so helpful & kind. Very efficient from the point of making my appointment. I was able to be seen with Toast our kitten,  new addition to the family, the same day. Thank you for keeping us up to date & for the gentle care.

I love Vetco. I bring all my babies here for wellness, spay/neuter, sick, anything. They listen to every single concern and help me any which way they can. After sick visits they even call to check up and listen to more of my concerns, stay on the phone, whatever I need.

Dr. Robinson and Leah provided excellent care for my fur baby. They were both attentive, reassuring, and genuinely compassionate.

Thank you for all your help!
Excellent customer service thank you very much Rebecca!

I was very happy .

Leah was very friendly and patient with cookie

Vetco administered her first shots, and did a PCR test, and she was diagnosed with ringworm. She tested negative for any parasites. We had already quarantined her and have started treatment. The vet tech and veterinarian were extremely professional and easy to communicate with.  They have followed up with us. The ease with which I was able to make an appointment on a Sunday for the next morning, once the other two cats were diagnosed, was easy and convenient.. I high recommend this veterinary service with their affordable pricing and professional service.

Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

This was our first visit to the Vetco clinic. We live in San Antonio so I made an appt at the nearest one which is the 125 NW Loop 410 location. Staff was great! We were in & out pretty quickly. We even received a followup call the next day after her shots! My MD doesn't even do this, so I was truly impressed & very appreciative! My cat Bella & I will definitely be making Vetco our regular vet clinic!! They have a FREE 1st visit coupon online that you should use & find out for yourself! It'll save you about $75. I have pet insurance w/Progressive so I filed my claim & received my $$ within 2 days from filing! I am looking into the insurance that Vetco carries though. There's also a Premier membership that is $25/mo that has many perks!

I am so glad to say that Cupcake is almost back to her playful, sassy self :) I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this team and Vetco location.

We had our checkup a few months back with her and I’m grateful it was Dr. Biler who could be there for us in the final moments of my dog’s life. As soon as she told us my dog’s heart from the injections, I started crying hard and Lyza came to give me a perfect little heart cut out of purple gauze which was the sweetest gesture. Losing a pet like my dog for the first time is/was unimaginable and the grief is horrible but Dr. Biler and Lyza were so respectful and kind to us while we had to deal with the worst thing for the first time in our life so I will forever be grateful to them.
